ranked.headline: Curated databases integrate single-cell and spatial transcriptomics across platforms
ranked.summary: Spatial platforms now span Visium, Xenium, MERFISH and Stereo-seq, motivating cross-platform harmonization within curated resources.

ranked.headline: Learned and mechanistic models infer single-cell state dynamics from lineage context
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair single-cell dynamical models with lineage tracing, gene regulatory networks, and biological constraints.

ranked.headline: Normalization and spatial testing sharpen single-cell and spatial expression readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply new normalization, probe-based spatial mapping and joint spatial testing to single-cell and spatial transcriptomes.

ranked.headline: Curated structure and affinity databases are benchmarking folding and pose predictors
ranked.summary: Recent releases add benchmark-ready splits, paired apo-holo states, and condition-resolved affinities to structure-based predictor evaluation.

ranked.headline: Genetic variants and tandem repeats reshape cell-type gene regulation
ranked.summary: Population-scale single-cell QTL maps now link variants and repeats to cell-type chromatin accessibility and expression.

ranked.headline: Generative models design full-length antibodies and binders across hard targets
ranked.summary: Pythia-1 designs full-length IgG agonists and antagonists for 22 targets, while new tools score humanness and orchestrate binder design.

ranked.headline: Split design and perturbation benchmarks reshape validity claims for single-cell models
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell foundation and virtual-cell preprints make split design and evaluation protocol decisive for trustworthy performance claims.

ranked.headline: Conditioned ML models predict protein interactions, peptides, hotspots, and stability
ranked.summary: Recent work conditions sequence and structure representations on domain, objective, and data choices for binding, hotspot, and stability prediction.

ranked.headline: Read-level methylation models and jagged-end correction refine cell-free DNA profiling
ranked.summary: Fragment-level and read-level methylation models now target technical artifacts that limit cell-free DNA methylation measurements.

ranked.headline: LLM agents with executable checks and provenance tracking for proteomics and taxonomy
ranked.summary: Agentic LLM tools now query proteomics datasets, extract protocol parameters from literature, and curate taxonomic names with traceable, checkable outputs.

ranked.headline: Modeling interaction-induced conformational change across protein complexes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target unbound-to-bound transitions and complex dynamics, extending structure prediction beyond static bound geometries.

ranked.headline: Knowledgebases unify bacterial genomes, arthropod and digester microbiomes
ranked.summary: Expanding reference resources now span bacterial genomes, arthropod and annelid symbionts, and methanogenic consortia.

ranked.headline: Resources linking GWAS variants to regulatory function and cell-type-resolved effects
ranked.summary: Recent resources and pipelines convert GWAS summary statistics into cell-type and regulatory annotations for interpreting disease variants.

ranked.headline: Linking genomic variation to function and selection across genomes and scales
ranked.summary: Pangenome, repeat, and haplotype resources now allow variation to be interpreted at multiple scales, from STRs to structural variants and selection.

ranked.headline: Predicting gene expression from H&E histology via residual and graph models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend image-based transcriptome inference to bulk, spatial, and single-cell readouts from whole-slide histopathology.

ranked.headline: Model-Based Biological Quantities from Single-Timepoint and Non-Contrast Brain Imaging
ranked.summary: Single-timepoint and non-contrast brain imaging is being mined for interpretable quantities such as proliferation ratios and expansion risk.

ranked.headline: Interpretable models expose folding, concept, and rewiring structure in biology
ranked.summary: Sparse autoencoders and hierarchical statistical tests now make learned biological models inspectable against folding and network readouts.

ranked.headline: LLM agents constrained by explicit evidence sources for biomedical analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether biology LLM agents ground conclusions in source documents and databases rather than free generation.

ranked.headline: Learned models prioritize protein variants and residues with calibrated uncertainty
ranked.summary: Current preprints pair sequence and structure predictors with conformal intervals, per-position attribution and leakage-controlled evaluation.

ranked.headline: Fused protein language model embeddings predict enzyme, variant, and kinase properties
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers combine multiple protein representations or site-aware modules to predict function, kinetics, temperature, and variant effects.

ranked.headline: Training data form and augmentation control performance in low-data molecular generation
ranked.summary: Scarce labeled data motivates controlling training data form, augmentation, or reward across molecular, DNA, and peptide generative models.

ranked.headline: Software unifies design and assessment of hybrid capture and oligo pool reagents
ranked.summary: Single tools now pair probe and library design with assessment, as BaitBench and PoolParty show in recent preprint and publication.

ranked.headline: Single-molecule footprinting frameworks map chromatin states and co-accessibility
ranked.summary: Single-molecule footprinting now yields per-molecule chromatin states and sequence-based co-accessibility models across diverse datasets.

ranked.headline: Spatially resolved models couple transport, diffusion, and geometry across scales
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published benchmark extend spatial models of transport, migration, and calcium diffusion to vascular and glial geometries.

ranked.headline: Pretrained genomic models adapted to cell-type and individual-level regulatory readouts
ranked.summary: Single-cell and individual-level genomic outputs are now being predicted from DNA sequence and genotypes using fine-tuned or extended pretrained models.

ranked.headline: Reference-controlled simulations probing RNA ensembles and helicase unwinding mechanisms
ranked.summary: Curated REST2 RNA ensemble data with reference-Hamiltonian forces allow simulation claims to be checked against a common standard.

ranked.headline: Simulations link non-equilibrium driving to condensate and chromatin phase organization
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and mesoscale simulations now model driven condensates as dynamic systems, not only as static endpoints.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies expose compartmentalized and nitrogen-fixing organelle genomes
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale nuclear and organellar assemblies now resolve genome compartmentalization and organelle-host metabolic remodeling across three preprints.

ranked.headline: Imbalance handling, active learning and model family in ADMET and hERG regression
ranked.summary: Protocol-matched benchmarks now test pipeline choices directly rather than assuming gains from new architectures.

ranked.headline: Bifurcation structure of neuronal and network models: degeneracy, delays, and bursting
ranked.summary: Recent items apply bifurcation analysis to neuron, subthalamic, delayed, and connectome models, linking parameter sets to dynamical regimes.

ranked.headline: Subgroup-aware regression and selection scores localize programs in scRNA-seq data
ranked.summary: Interpretable scRNA-seq methods now link gene-level selection and evolutionary signals to specific cell contexts within tissues.

ranked.headline: MD simulations and HDX-MS jointly resolve protein conformational dynamics
ranked.summary: Ensemble-based reweighting and hydrogen-bond network analysis are now being coupled to HDX-MS readouts for structural interpretation.

ranked.headline: Updated curated databases expand enhancer, lncRNA, and rice expression evidence
ranked.summary: Recent database updates add experimental evidence records and AI-assisted search, while a CRISPR knockout feasibility workflow appears as a preprint.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked transcript quantification and isoform tools with internal self-validation
ranked.summary: Recent transcriptome tools report benchmarks against Kallisto, Salmon, and TransRate, emphasizing reference-free and self-validating quality control.

ranked.headline: Queryable, source-linked knowledgebases integrating clinical and molecular evidence in…
ranked.summary: Curated resources now pair clinical and molecular records with LLM-assisted curation, making heterogeneous evidence queryable and traceable to its sources.

ranked.headline: Constraint-based robustness and GPR-aware gene deletion ranking for microbial metabolism
ranked.summary: Perturbation-based robustness estimates now pair with GPR-aware gene-deletion ranking to prioritize microbial strain engineering interventions.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide and complex I models extend mitochondrial DNA variant pathogenicity scoring
ranked.summary: Mitochondrial variant interpretation has largely covered protein-coding genes; new resources now target non-coding and complex I positions.

ranked.headline: Predicted protein structures feed curated resources and surface-level screens
ranked.summary: Predicted structures are being standardized into reusable annotation for antigen construct design and fold assignment.

ranked.headline: Reduced dynamical models convert treatment failure into dosing and relapse predictions
ranked.summary: Model-based predictions of relapse and dosing schedules are now emerging across CLL, CML and drug-persister settings.

ranked.headline: Integrated reporting and reference choice reshape computational variant interpretation
ranked.summary: Long-read co-occurrence, reference choice and integrated mtDNA reporting are now being combined in variant interpretation workflows.
